items.stem: On a large codebase, why can adding many unrelated files to the AI's context reduce suggestion quality?

options.text: Irrelevant context dilutes the signal the model uses to answer
options.rationale: Correct: noisy, irrelevant context makes it harder for the model to focus on the task.

options.text: It is impossible to add more than one file
options.rationale: Multiple files can be added; the issue is relevance.
Encryption is not the issue here.

options.text: More files always guarantee a better answer
options.rationale: More is not always better; relevance matters.

items.explanation: Correct: noisy, irrelevant context makes it harder for the model to focus on the task.

items.stem: Which TWO practices belong in a disciplined AI-assisted editing workflow? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Read the generated diff before accepting it
options.rationale: Correct: reviewing the diff catches subtle or unwanted changes.

options.text: Run tests against the generated change
options.rationale: Correct: tests validate that the change behaves correctly.

options.text: Accept all suggestions automatically to save time
Skip review because the AI wrote it
options.rationale: AI authorship is a reason to review, not to skip review.

items.explanation: Correct: reviewing the diff catches subtle or unwanted changes.

items.stem: How are project conventions best communicated to an AI coding assistant?

options.text: By defining explicit project rules/conventions it can follow
options.rationale: Correct: explicit rules steer suggestions toward the project's patterns (exact mechanism pending official docs).

options.text: By assuming it infers them with no guidance
options.rationale: Conventions should be stated, not assumed.
Deleting tests harms quality and does not communicate conventions.

options.text: By hiding the codebase from the tool
options.rationale: Hiding context does not communicate conventions.

items.explanation: Correct: explicit rules steer suggestions toward the project's patterns (exact mechanism pending official docs).
